Gulf Academy Movie Awards (GAMA Awards) is an annual film awards ceremony recognizing achievements in Telugu cinema. The event is held in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and primarily honors artists and technicians from the Telugu film industry.
History
The GAMA Awards were established in the early 2010s and have been held in Dubai as part of cultural events associated with the Indian diaspora in the Gulf region. Early editions of the awards were held between 2013 and 2015.
After a gap of several years, the awards returned with subsequent editions recognizing films released across multiple years.
Award categories
The awards are presented across a range of categories, including:
* Best Film
* Best Director
* Best Actor
* Best Actress
* Best Supporting Actor
* Best Supporting Actress
* Best Music Director
* Best Playback Singer
* Best Cinematography
* Best Screenplay
* Best Debut Actor or Actress
* Lifetime Achievement Award
Ceremonies
Multiple editions of the GAMA Awards have been held in Dubai, featuring participation from Indian film personalities.
The fourth edition of the awards was held in March 2024 in Dubai, recognizing films from multiple years.
The fifth edition of the awards was held in 2025 at the Sharjah Expo Centre in the United Arab Emirates.
Media coverage
The awards have received coverage in Indian media. Actress Urvashi Rautela received a "Fan’s Favourite" recognition at the GAMA Awards held in Dubai.
The event has also been covered by publications such as Deccan Chronicle.
